components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single green action per step: 52px, 12px radius, no border. Hover lightens to Green Hover.
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height: 52px; padding: 0 20px; background: var(--g-500, #0fbf3e); color: var(--n-900, #101411); border: 0; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; font: 700 1.0625rem 'Mona Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-primary:hover { background: var(--g-300, #5fed83); } .ds-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--g-300, #5fed83); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tool Button
components.description: Quiet raised control for Undo and Start over. Border brightens on hover; pressed state uses a green border.
components.html: <button class="ds-tool"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 10h11a6 6 0 0 1 0 12"/><path d="m7 6-4 4 4 4"/></svg>Undo</button>
components.css: .ds-tool { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; background: var(--n-800, #232925); border: 1px solid var(--line, #2f3631); border-radius: 10px; color: var(--n-50, #f2f5f3); font: 600 0.875rem 'Mona Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tool:hover { border-color: var(--n-500, #909692); } .ds-tool[aria-pressed='true'] { border-color: var(--g-500, #0fbf3e); } .ds-tool:disabled { color: var(--n-500, #909692); cursor: default; }

components.name: Route Navigation
components.description: Header links on the dark chrome; the current page carries a 2px green underline.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-nav a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--n-300, #b6bfb8); font: 600 0.9375rem 'Mona Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--n-50, #f2f5f3); background: var(--n-800, #232925); } .ds-nav a[aria-current='page'] { color: var(--n-50, #f2f5f3); box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 var(--g-500, #0fbf3e); border-radius: 8px 8px 0 0; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Assembled/Exploded and Dark/Light on the stage's lower edge. Selected segment is Paper on Chrome Ink.
components.css: .ds-segment { display: inline-flex; padding: 3px; gap: 2px; background: rgba(16, 20, 17, 0.9); border-radius: 10px; } .ds-segment button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--n-300, #b6bfb8); font: 600 0.875rem 'Mona Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-segment button:hover { color: var(--n-50, #f2f5f3); } .ds-segment button[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--n-50, #f2f5f3); color: var(--n-900, #101411); } .ds-swatch { width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35); }

components.name: Stage
components.description: The light working surface that holds the box and the keyboard; 16px radius, clipped, ink text.
components.css: .ds-stage { position: relative; min-height: 240px; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--n-100, #e4ebe6); color: var(--n-900, #101411); overflow: hidden; padding: 16px; font: 400 1rem/1.5 'Mona Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Assembly Stepper
components.description: Six circular numbered marks; done steps are filled green with a check, the current step is filled Paper, future steps are outlined Muted.
components.html:
1. Open your kit
  2. 2Stabilizers
  3. 3Switches
components.css: .ds-stepper { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 2px; background: var(--n-900, #101411); padding: 12px; } .ds-stepper li { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 32px; color: var(--n-500, #909692); font: 600 0.9375rem 'Mona Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-stepper .mark { width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; border: 1.5px solid var(--n-500, #909692); font-size: 0.75rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; flex: none; } .ds-stepper .is-done { color: var(--n-300, #b6bfb8); } .ds-stepper .is-done .mark { background: var(--g-500, #0fbf3e); border-color: var(--g-500, #0fbf3e); color: var(--n-900, #101411); } .ds-stepper .is-current { color: var(--n-50, #f2f5f3); } .ds-stepper .is-current .mark { background: var(--n-50, #f2f5f3); border-color: var(--n-50, #f2f5f3); color: var(--n-900, #101411); }

components.name: Progress
components.description: 6px track and green fill with a tabular count line, shown only when a step has countable parts.
components.css: .ds-progress { display: grid; gap: 8px; } .ds-progress .bar { height: 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--n-800, #232925); overflow: hidden; } .ds-progress .bar span { display: block; height: 100%; width: 100%; background: var(--g-500, #0fbf3e); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 0.25s; } .ds-progress .text { color: var(--n-300, #b6bfb8); font: 400 0.875rem 'Mona Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Blind Box

components.name: Photo Tile
components.description: Borderless 3:2 image on Raised Ink; the image scales 1.03 on hover.
components.html: <button class="ds-tile"><svg viewBox="0 0 3 2" width="220" height="147" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="3" height="2" fill="#909692"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-tile { display: block; width: 220px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--n-800, #232925); cursor: pointer; } .ds-tile svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; aspect-ratio: 3 / 2; transition: transform 0.25s; } .ds-tile:hover svg { transform: scale(1.03); }

narrative.overview:
A near-black GitHub chrome holds one large, pale stage. The keyboard is the page: the dark shell recedes, the light stage makes the hardware read like an object on a bench, and GitHub Green appears only where something is done or about to be done. Mona Sans carries all text. The interface is flat; there is no UI shadow.

The world is the kit itself: a sealed cardboard blind box, parts rising out to bench slots, then a photo-faithful Omnitype Bauer Lite with a red bottom housing, blue plate, clear top housing, Dark or Light keycaps and blue accent keys. Hardware and cardboard colors are product material and live only on the stage.
keyCharacteristics: Dark chrome, light stage: two grounds and no mid-tones between them.
GitHub Green #0FBF3E on the primary action, progress, completed steps and the current-nav underline only.
One family, Mona Sans, with hierarchy from size and weight alone.
Flat surfaces separated by 1px lines and tonal steps; 8–16px radii.
One instruction and one primary action at a time.

rules.name: The Green Is Earned Rule
rules.body: Green means act, progress, or done. Never a text-block background, never decoration, never a status for anything unverified. Completion pairs a check with the green mark.

rules.name: The Hardware Stays on the Stage Rule
rules.body: Red, blue, cardboard and keycap colors never appear in the header, panel, buttons or pages. The shell has exactly one chromatic color.

rules.name: The No Purple, No Blue UI Rule
rules.body: GitHub's purple and blue brand colors are not used for interface. Blue exists only as the product's accent keys and plate.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is size and weight in Mona Sans. No second face, no monospace, no all-caps UI labels.

rules.name: The Flat Shell Rule
rules.body: No shadows, glows, glass or gradients on buttons, panels or the header. Depth is the object's job.

dos: **Do** keep the shell to the green-tinted neutral scale plus GitHub Green on the primary action.
**Do** keep the stage light and the chrome dark.
**Do** use Green Deep (#08872B) for focus and outlines on the stage and Green Hover (#5FED83) on the dark shell.
**Do** show one instruction and one primary action, with the primary button in the first mobile screen.
**Do** keep Dark and Light as the only keycap options.
**Do** keep controls at least 40px tall and honor prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: **Don't** use purple or blue brand colors for interface, or tint the shell with hardware colors.
**Don't** add shadows, glows, glassmorphism or gradient fills to chrome.
**Don't** add kickers, eyebrows, slogans, repeated warnings or all-caps UI labels.
**Don't** introduce a second typeface or a display face.
**Don't** add video links beyond the single click-to-play embed in the guide.
**Don't** invent colorways or recolor the supplied photographs.
**Don't** replace SVG icons with glyph characters.
